Install the new OPR on your phone

Two minutes, once. Swap the old app for the new one.

1

Remove the old OPR

Press and hold the old OPR icon on your home screen.

Android: choose Uninstall (or drag it to Uninstall).

iPhone: choose Remove App, then Delete.

2

On Android

Open the link above in Chrome.

Tap the ⋮ menu (top right).

Tap Add to Home screen (or Install app), then Add.

3

On iPhone

Open the link above in Safari.

Tap the Share button (the square with the arrow).

Scroll down, tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.

That's it. Tap the new OPR icon, open your group, switch on Make this my home page, and you're set.

How OPR works: one system, your club in charge

Eswatini is now part of a bigger system. Here is what that means, and what stays yours.

The whole system
OPR · Open Padel Ratings
Every club and group on OPR, and every player's one rating.
Your front door
Eswatini
Holds its groups and shows all their results together.
Your group
01 - OPR - MCC & LIV and the other Eswatini groups
Its own page, colour, code, members, scores, ladder, court card and tournaments.

One rating, everywhere. Every player, and every pair, has one OPR rating. It counts the same on every club and group on the system, so a match played anywhere on OPR moves the same rating.

Your group runs itself. Every group keeps its own page and colour, its own members list, scores, ladder, court card and tournaments. Its members, settings and matches are looked after by its own organisers, in its own admin room, with its own code.

Part of something bigger. Your results also count across Eswatini and the whole system. Compare yourself with players everywhere under Ratings · Ladders · Profiles and, for the whole system, the Global Ledger at the bottom of that page.

Nothing to set up for players. Your organiser adds each player once. From then on you just enter scores; the ratings, ladders and tables update themselves.

Find your way around

Your owner's guide. It starts at the Eswatini front door and walks through every button, so nothing is missed. The numbers on the pictures match the numbers in the text.

12345678

The front door: top half

1

The front door: Eswatini. This is the holding area for every group on the system. The banner shows how many groups, members and tournaments there are.

2

My page. Your own page: your rating, your partners and every match you've played.

3

Enter your match score. Tap it and a page opens asking which group you played in (or which tournament). Tap it, fill in the players and the set scores, and save. The match shows straight away and the ratings move.

4

Select your active groups. Choose which groups show on this front door: switch each one on or off, move it up or down with the arrows, or use All on / All off. It's remembered on your phone.

5

Group cards One card for every group in Eswatini. Swipe sideways to see them all (the dots show how many). The number is that group's matches. Tap Enter here to open a group: its own scores, ratings, ladder, members, court card and tournaments.

6

Quick buttons. Ratings · Ladders · Profiles, Tournaments, and Up (back to the top). When there are fresh results, Form & Move appears here too. The row stays at the top while you scroll.

7

Recent matches. The latest results from every group. The coloured tag names the group; S is a social match, L a ladder match, T a tournament match. Tap ▼ for the set scores. Scroll inside the box for more.

8

The bottom bar, on every page: Club home (back to this door), Enter a score and My page. The ← or ‹ back at the top left always takes you one step back.

9101112

Scroll down the front door

9

Last match. The most recent result in Eswatini: who played, the score and how long ago. Tap the arrow for the details.

10

Tournaments running. Every tournament on the go, each tagged with the group running it. Tap one for its draw, results and standings.

11

Everything else. The quiet row at the bottom:

  • My page: your own page, as above.
  • All tournaments: every tournament in Eswatini, running and finished, with the final standings.
  • Club admin: for organisers only; each room asks for its code.
  • About OPR: how the ratings work, in plain words.
12

Then the build number, e.g. "OPR · build n352". If something looks wrong, tell your organiser which build you are on.

Ratings, pairs and profiles

From the front door: Ratings · Ladders · Profiles → Ratings and ladders. Every name you see is a door to more: tap it.

1 · Choose a table

Pair ratings: Men's, Ladies', Mixed and All Sorts.

Universal: every pair together.

Club ladder and Form (who's on a run).

2 · The pair table

Every pair ranked: Rating, Level (the rating divided by 200) and Move (up or down since they started).

Search by name. Tap a pair.

3 · A pair's page

Rating, level, rank and move; matches, sets, win % and games per set.

Chart Snapshot, every match they played together, and both players: tap one.

4 · A player's profile

Rating, level, rank and move; the last 8 weeks.

Move by group, Partnerships (who they play best with) and the rating chart, match by match.

Also under Ratings · Ladders · Profiles: List all members (everyone in Eswatini, with their group) and Member profiles (tap any name). The ← top left always steps back one page.

★

Start your own group

Eswatini is yours to grow. Make a group for anything that plays together:

  • a ladies' group or a men's night
  • another club
  • a challenge, league or social section

How: ask your organiser. They open Club admin → Eswatini — Region Ledger (★, with the Eswatini code) and add New group: a name, a colour and the group's own code.

The new group gets its own page, scores, ladder, court card and tournaments, and shares the same players and their one rating. It appears on the front door at once; switch it on or off under Select your active groups.

Have fun, look around, and most of all, enjoy.
